text:
incident-bot: [PagerDuty] High 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway-eu-west1. Metric: 5xx_rate=7.4% over 5m, p95 latency up. Pager: urgent
alex: acked via PagerDuty, taking initial triage.
mira: on-call, I'll take it. joining in ~2m to grab keyboard.
sam: seeing a sharp increase in 502/503s at the gateway layer, starting at 03:12 UTC. Spike correlates with burst of long-context requests.
jon: throwing links: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/gateway - 5xx spike; logs: https://logs.redwood/entries?q=eu-west1+502
infra-bot: autoscaler reports limited spare capacity on ded-pool-eu-west1 (gpu-pod-saturation=0.92)
alex: can we failover some traffic to eu-central? what's the current routing policy?
mira: routing policy is region-preferred -> fallback to global if latency threshold breached. I'll open a manual route for 10% to eu-central as test.
sam: quick mitigation: reduce max-connections to gateway backends to avoid queue blowup. patching envoy: `kubectl -n gateway set env deploy/envoy MAX_CONN=200` and `kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-gateway --replicas=6`
Code snippet:
```
# scale inference gateway
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-gateway --replicas=6
# verify pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o wide
```
mira: executing scale now (kubectl applied). Also clearing prefix/KV cache on a couple of hot nodes: `/usr/local/bin/kv-cache-clear --node node-12`
jon: FYI: rolling restart started for gateway pods, log tail shows transient 502s but should stabilize.
emily-support: flagged 3 customers as affected: corp-zen, synth-ai, quickforms — CS reaching out with proactive note, no PII exposed.
alex: monitoring: 5xx_rate down from 7.4% -> 1.3% after scale and route. p95 latency returning to baseline.
sam: looks like the root cause was a small subset of long-context requests that exhausted kv cache and caused downstream model-serving 503s. Need followup: increase kv cache limits + add rate-limits for extremely long requests.
mira: putting a canary alert and adding a postmortem task: owners infra/serving/sg. Runbook followed: scaling + route + cache-clear. Runbook link: https://playbooks/redwood/inference-5xx
alex: opening incident ticket I-2021-432 and adding timeline.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident I-2021-432 acknowledged by alex. Escalation suspended.
emily-support: customers notified, shared ETA for full resolution. No further outage reports.
mira: marking primary mitigations complete. continuing to monitor for 30m.
alex: handing over to next oncall @sam in 20m for watch.
sam: ack, will pick up monitoring and follow with followup action items.
mira: closing this thread in slack, will paste postmortem draft into #postmortems within 48h. :white_check_mark:
